jobSearch.title: Finding Work in Europe

jobSearch.description: We provide professional guidance in the job search process in the healthcare sector. Thanks to our strong network with hospitals and healthcare institutions in Europe, we help you find positions suitable for you.
jobSearch.detail: We are with you throughout the entire process from CV preparation to interview.
jobSearch.footer: We have career counseling services specific to your profession and job opportunities.

visaApplication.title: Application Process Support
visaApplication.subtitle: Application Process

about.title: A different kind of consultancy.
about.description: We offer comprehensive services to achieve your international career goals in healthcare, service, construction and other sectors.

content.paragraph1: Healthcare, service, construction and other sectors are constantly changing and developing. The need for qualified personnel in Europe is increasing every day. Now is the right time to seize this opportunity.
content.highlight: Working in Europe is not just a dream. We make it a reality for you.
content.paragraph2: Our team, which has worked in these sectors for years, has faced all the challenges in the settlement processes of different professional groups in Europe. Traditional methods are not sufficient. We offer a comprehensive consultancy service specially designed for healthcare, service, construction and other sectors.

architectureSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know
architectureSection.title: Work process in Europe
architectureSection.description: Europe is known for its strong economy, culture and high quality of life. However, for immigrants, moving to Europe means more than just a new career; it is the beginning of a new life in a new environment.

integration.title: Employee integration
integration.description: After international employees successfully reach Europe, the critical process of integration begins. Good integration is important not only to ensure that new employees feel comfortable in their new environment, but also to ensure long-term commitment to the company.

experiencedVisa.title: Visa for experienced professionals
experiencedVisa.description: What is an experienced professional visa? The visa for experienced professionals (Section 19c of the Residence Act, Paragraph 2) is aimed at skilled workers who have at least two years of qualified professional experience in their field but do not have a formal university degree.

acceleratedProcedures.title: Accelerated procedures
acceleratedProcedures.description: What is the accelerated skilled worker procedure? The Accelerated Skilled Worker Procedure is a special process developed to accelerate the immigration and recognition process for skilled workers from abroad.

recruitment.title: Recruitment
recruitment.description: Step by step. Recruiting international specialists offers a tremendous opportunity to address the skills shortage in Europe. However, for this process to be successful, companies need to adopt a targeted and structured approach.
